chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from some of our companions from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Regarding
a woman who accused her husband (of adultery) while he was deaf, he said: 'They are separated, and she is not permissible for him ever.'

key_terms.قَذَفَتْ: Accused (specifically of zina/adultery in the context of li'an)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on li'an if the husband is deaf?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies that in the case of *li'an* between a wife and a deaf husband, the separation is permanent (*ba'in*), distinguishing it from cases where the husband can hear and respond. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly view that the deafness does not impede the validity of the mutual oaths, ensuring the finality of the divorce once the ritual is completed.
